defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its `dist[i][mask]` shortest-connection formulation does not correctly maintain the cost of one connected subgraph containing every target in the mask, so its state transitions can fail to represent the required Steiner tree.

The union-find-based approach treats the task as an MST-style edge-selection problem and does not correctly optimize a minimum Steiner tree when non-target variables are useful as intermediate vertices.
The sorted-edge DSU approach is likewise an MST/Kruskal heuristic rather than an exact minimum-cost connected subgraph computation for the specified terminal set.

recommended_edit: No semantics-preserving edit can defeat the surviving solution while retaining the immutable bound t ≤ 10. If a presentation-only edit is required, stop explicitly advertising the small-terminal structure and describe the query through a fixed-size terminal scenario instead; defeating subset DP would require changing the effective terminal bound or the task.
regression_risk: A presentation-only edit is unlikely to restore the already-defeated MST-based solutions; changing the actual terminal bound or connectivity semantics would change the problem rather than merely remove an affordance.
